title: Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure
Enterprise Aplication Security Engineer II
Enterprise Security Engineer II
Senior Solutions Architect, NVIDIA Cloud Partner Operations
description_html: NVIDIA is looking for a hands-on Solutions Architect to raise the Day 2 operations bar across our NVIDIA Cloud Partner ecosystem. Day 2 starts when a cluster is installed and validated: keeping the service healthy, adapting it as technology and customer demand change, and improving performance, stability, efficiency and economics over time. You will work with engineers running AI clouds at scale on the problems that decide whether customers stay and whether the next generation of NVIDIA technology lands successfully.    Our job is to work hand in hand with NCPs to solve real problems and drive real optimizations, prove the answer, and turn it into something the next partner can use! This is not an outsourced operations role. The partner owns its cloud; success means leaving its team more capable, not more dependent on ours.     What you'll be doing:     Solve hard Day 2 operations problems at scale. Work alongside partner engineers to find the cause, prototype an approach, validate it under representative load, and leave behind a practice their team can operate.    Make new technology Day 2 ready. Help partners prepare the operating model for new NVIDIA platforms, capacity, services, and use cases before customers depend on them, and help drive adoption in live environments without degrading service.    Improve reliability, performance, and economics together. Use measures such as incident frequency, recovery time, utilization, and cost per token to show where the cloud is losing performance or margin - and whether the fix worked.    Raise each partner's Day 2 maturity. Identify and help close the gaps that matter across people, process, tooling, telemetry, security, and incident response.    Turn one solution into ecosystem capability. Convert validated work into operating procedures, reference architectures, assessments, automation, and agentic workflows that other NCPs can integrate into their standard operating model.    Create the feedback loop only NVIDIA can. Spot patterns across partners early and bring clear field evidence to account teams, support, product, and engineering so repeated problems are fixed at the right level.       What we need to see:     BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field - or equivalent experience.    12+ years in production infrastructure, cloud engineering, solutions architecture, site reliability engineering, HPC, or a similar technical role; alternatively, 5+ years of exceptional specialist-level work in large-scale GPU or AI infrastructure.    Experience building, operating, or improving distributed infrastructure under real production load - not only designing or deploying it.    Deep expertise in at least one part of the Day 2 stack, backed by hands-on work with large-scale GPU, HPC, or cloud infrastructure. Relevant technologies may include DCGM, BMC/Redfish, and firmware and driver lifecycle; InfiniBand or high-speed Ethernet, NCCL, and UFM; or high-performance storage such as Lustre, IBM Storage Scale, WEKA, VAST Data, or comparable platforms.    Working experience across the broader operating platform, including Kubernetes or Slurm, GPU scheduling and multi-tenancy, Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry, and automation with Terraform, Ansible, Argo CD, or similar tooling.    Strong Linux knowledge and enough Python, Bash, or similar experience to automate measurement, diagnosis, validation, or remediation.    A detailed evidence-led approach to troubleshooting across system boundaries, paired with the judgment to make difficult technical findings clear.    The ability to lead sophisticated work with partner engineers and cross-functional teams without direct authority or taking ownership away from the operator.    Strong communication, prioritization, and time-management skills across multiple partner engagements.       Ways to stand out from the crowd:     Real world experience operating a GPU cloud, HPC environment, or large-scale AI platform under customer load.    Built or matured a 24/7 operations function, including observability, incident and problem management, coverage, and on-call design.    Hands on experience with NVIDIA rack-scale platforms such as GB200 or GB300 NVL72 into production, or have hands-on experience with NVIDIA operations technologies such as Spectrum-X, UFM, Base Command Manager, Mission Control, and the GPU or Network Operators.    Driven improved fleet health or unit economics through benchmarking, infrastructure as code, GitOps, automated diagnosis, or agent-based remediation.      Even if your background doesn't match every line above, we'd love to hear how your experience applies.    With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. This role presents an opportunity to have a wide impact at NVIDIA by improving the factory planning function. Are you creative, hard-working, dedicated, and determined? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you!     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 16, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Principal Architect — Security, Privacy and Governance in Large-scale Enterprise Agentic-AI Solutions
description_html: ADOBE     -       Enterprise Customer Experience Platform             Principal Architect — Security,     Privacy and Governance in Large-  scale       Enterprise     Agentic  -  AI     Solution  s         San Jose, CA (Hybrid, min. 3-4 days/  week onsite)       ·   Level: Principal    ·   Full-time            Summary           At A  dobe  , we are   building     enterprise-grade Agentic  -  AI systems that automate large-scale data access and workflow execution for business processes.     These systems not only embody foundational enterprise security and privacy     considerations     but also     provide robust and safet  y-preserving capabilities in the emerging world of agent identity, delegated access     control     and human-i  n-the-loop execution models.              This is a     multi  -fluency role: you need the     distributed systems     and Agentic  -  AI depth to architect how     agents     reason, plan, and act at scale, and the security-and-compliance     mechanisms that manage safe and trustworthy execution.     You will partner with engineering, product, legal/privacy, and security leadership to turn fast-moving agentic AI     capabilities     into a governed, enterprise-ready platform  .              Key Responsibilities           Agentic AI Architecture             Define and drive the end-to-end reference architecture for how AI agents     are     authenticate  d and     authorized     to     access enterprise data, tools, and systems across Adobe's     Customer     Experience Platform — covering agent lifecycle management, interaction protocols, memory/context handling, and action-execution frameworks.               Evaluate and select frameworks, protocols, and platforms (e.g., agentic orchestration frameworks, MCP-style tool systems, policy engines such as OPA/Cedar-class authorization) that best support secure, governed multi-agent systems at Adobe's scale.             Security, Compliance & Privacy by Design             Own the security architecture for agent-to-system and agent-to-agent interactions: identity and workload authentication, least-privilege authorization, secrets and credential mediation, network egress controls, runtime isolation, and telemetry/audit evidence sufficient to satisfy internal audit and external regulators.               Embed privacy-by-design and compliance requirements (data governance, consent, data residency, retention) directly into the agent architecture rather than bolting them on after the fact; partner with Legal/Privacy to keep architecture decisions ahead of regulatory expectations for autonomous AI systems.             Cross-Organizational Leadership & Standards             Lead architectural reviews and set standards for scalability, resiliency, observability, and cost efficiency — with security and compliance treated as first-class, non-negotiable design constraints rather than downstream     signoffs  .                 Contribute to or lead an Architecture Review Board function for agentic AI, ensuring new capabilities are evaluated consistently against Adobe's governance bar before they ship.             Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Evangelism            Serve as Adobe's senior technical authority and encouraging leader on secure agentic AI architecture. Mentor senior engineers and architects. Elevate security and privacy proficiency across the broader engineering organization.             Create and     maintain     architecture documentation, decision records, and threat models that are equally useful to implementation teams and to senior leadership.             Executive & Customer Engagement              Represent Adobe's agentic AI security and governance posture to executive leadership , enterprise customers, and — where relevant — regulators and standards bodies, with clear, bounded claims about maturity, open risks, and the evidence     required     before broader rollout.                Provide thought leadership  across the     organization     where agentic AI access governance is heading, and shape Adobe's roadmap accordingly.             Basic Qualifications             20+ years of experience in software engineering or security architecture, with a strong focus on distributed systems, platform engineering, and enterprise-scale access control.                Deep understanding of agentic AI architecture patterns : agent orchestration, tool/function calling, reasoning and planning loops, and multi-agent coordination, along with the risks specific to each.                Expert-level knowledge  of identity and access management, authorization models, and credential/secrets management (e.g., OAuth/OIDC, SAML, workload identity, policy-as-code approaches such as OPA/Rego or Cedar-class engines).              Demonstrated ability to lead ambiguous initiatives involving multiple functions across security, product, legal/privacy, and infrastructure teams, and to influence org-wide standards without direct authority.           Preferred Qualifications             Practical experience with       agent-lifecycle governance, including audit evidence generation and anomaly/incident response for autonomous systems.               Familiarity with privacy and compliance frameworks relevant to AI systems (e.g., data residency, consent management  , and sectoral     regulatory expectations for automated decision-making).               Experience building or governing developer platforms, cloud-native services, or streaming data platforms (e.g., Kafka, Spark) at enterprise scale.                 Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Security, or related technical field.                Experience standing up or contributing to an enterprise Architecture Review Board or equivalent governance function.              Success Profile             Strong systems     thinker     who can simplify genuinely hard problems — you make governance     transparent     without making it     burdensome  .               Comfortable operating at both hands-on technical depth and strategic, executive-facing leadership.               High ownership, high bias for execution, and     a track record     of turning a working draft into a production-grade, adopted standard.               Why This Role Is Different           Most “agentic AI architect” roles ask you to build agent capability. Most “security architect” roles ask you to review someone else's     designs and implementations  . This role asks you to do both at once, for one of the largest enterprise software platforms in the world — defining not just what Adobe's agents can do, but proving, to auditors and customers alike, that what they do is     safe, governed     and trustworthy. You will shape the     security     standard     for enterprise Agentic AI solutions that     other companies benchmark against, not just implement one.          About Adobe   Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
